title: Catgirl Mail Delivery
description: Two views of a blonde catgirl with black ears and crown standing beside a red mailbox. She wears a tattered black and red off-shoulder dress with fishnet stockings and holds a glowing golden package. A smaller inset painting on the left shows her in a yellow dress version. The background is a surreal graveyard with tombstones, dead trees, and a warm sunset sky.
prompt: A beautiful blonde catgirl with black cat ears and an ornate black crown stands next to a bright red mailbox in a misty graveyard at sunset. She wears a torn black and red off-shoulder gothic dress with fishnet stockings and holds a glowing golden package with runes. Her hair is braided with a black bow.
